dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Max Squared was surrendered by his owner due to their personal circumstances. His previous owner reports that he is a playful dog who enjoys quality time with his people, and loves squeaky toys, playing fetch, car rides, and long walks in the park. During his stay in care, he has shown highly fearful behavior and has allowed only minimal handling, hard barking, lunging, growling, and snarling at staff. Due to these concerns, we recommend he is placed in an adult-only home through a New Hope partner that can allow him the time and space to decompress and acclimate at his own pace.
dog.name: Max Squared
